content: The memory extension stores NDJSON with atomic appends, repairs malformed non-empty lines during initialization, and exposes memory_repair for on-demand recovery.
Pi natively enables or disables installed package extensions via `pi config`, with global and project-local resource filters persisted in settings.json.
Shared pi-tools configuration lives in lib/pi-tools-config.ts with defaults < global < trusted-project precedence and is tested by `npm run test:config`.
The always-available `extensions/pi-tools-settings.ts` provides registry-driven `/pi-tools` UI and scoped status/get/set/enable/disable commands; saved edits reload Pi when the UI closes.
`npm run format` runs Prettier across the repository; Prettier is a devDependency.
Tool-call compression research is indexed in `research/index.md`, with prior-art and technique records in the repository-root `research/` directory.
Pi 0.82.1 truncates LLM `bash` output before `tool_result` to its last 2,000 lines or 50 KiB, exposing full raw output only through a temporary-file path on successful truncation.

extensions/tool-output-compression/ provides observe-default result profiles, exact reuse, session-scoped raw retrieval, and the /tool-output dashboard; its tests run through npm run test:compression.
Tool-output compression uses a private SQLite store with WAL, synchronous=FULL, 600-permission files, bounded busy retries, retention/quota controls, and session-scoped retrieve_tool_output chunks.
`/tool-output` reports potential savings in observe mode and actual applied exact-reuse savings in apply mode, while `/tool-output prune` and `vacuum` maintain the SQLite store.
The root package declares `"type": "module"`, so Node runs the TypeScript ESM tests without `MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON` reparsing warnings.

The registered Vitest output profile uses `profiles.test.vitest.mode`, defaults to observe, and strictly compacts only standalone successful file-level or test-level reporter output after durable raw storage.
The registered bash JSON/JSONL profile uses profiles.structured.json.mode, defaults to observe, lexically minifies complete or line-bounded embedded values, and uses session-scoped raw retrieval.
The registered search-records bash profile uses profiles.search.records.mode, defaults to observe, and reversibly groups certified rg/grep opaque prefix:<decimal>:suffix records with raw retrieval.
The code-search extension shell is in extensions/code-search/, registers shared mode/output/budget settings, and has dedicated npm run test:code-search lifecycle tests.

extensions/code-search/worker.ts owns trusted-project SQLite discovery, Tree-sitter symbol indexing, validation refresh, source-free queries, and the optional session watcher through a typed worker protocol.

extensions/code-search/metrics.ts provides a private WAL/FULL SQLite daily aggregate store for code-search mode/event counts, latency, result/emitted bytes, budget limits, freshness, and rolling retention without source, query, path, or per-call data.

Trusted non-off code-search sessions persist aggregate metrics in metrics.sqlite; `/code-search [prune]` renders/prunes these 90-day-configurable rows, and apply-mode tools record actual latency, result count, emitted bytes, budget pressure, and freshness.
The custom stats footer measures last and aggregate TPS from assistant message_start-to-message_end stream intervals using final usage.output, so tool execution time is excluded.

Trusted non-off code-search sessions persist aggregate metrics in Pi's global agent `code-search-metrics.sqlite`; `/code-search [prune]` renders/prunes these globally configured retention rows, and apply-mode tools record actual latency, result count, emitted bytes, budget pressure, and freshness.
Pi 0.83.0 includes an official `examples/extensions/subagent/` extension that runs isolated `pi --mode json -p --no-session` child processes with single, parallel, and chained delegation modes.

The subagents extension publishes enabled, maxConcurrentWorkers (integer, default 2), models.task, and models.research settings and resolves trusted-project launch policy before creating a worker session.

extensions/subagents/supervisor.ts manages injectable persistent SDK worker sessions with retry disabled, atomic manifests and terse journals in tmp/subagents, shared immediate-refusal concurrency, Git observation, and paused interrupted-work recovery.
